name: sprite_sheet
description: Generate animated sprite sheets: character action frames via image-gen, background removal, grid assembly. These lanes are AGENT-DRIVEN card chains (2026-09-04 flows rework): drive each stage card through the queue door ({model: ...}); there is no single-shot yaml door anymore (dev_docs/queue/flows.md).

character.description: Character description (e.g. 'a knight in silver armor')

actions.description: Action names: idle, walk_left, walk_right, jump, attack, etc.

cols.description: Columns in the output grid. Default: number of actions.

seed.description: Base seed. Each frame gets seed + i.
